limits: No character turnarounds or back/side orthographic design sheets located; the full-body portraits are a single posed view.
Rex face, eye color, hair and civilian outfit remain unspecified by these sources. Masked face/back/first-person hands are supported production choices.
Cope and later player Rex are different individuals; a shared REX helmet does not transfer Cope face to the player.
Promo body/clothing phase is not a universal costume for every mission; Coster flight gear vs gray T-shirt and Tasha jacket-on/off must follow scene continuity.
No frame extraction from official videos was necessary in this collection; do not claim those videos were fully watched.
